description: This file defines a class 'dm_network_ssid_t' that encapsulates operations related to network SSID information, including initialization, decoding from JSON, encoding, conversions between string and enum representations, and comparison operators. The class interacts with 'em_network_ssid_info_t' structures and includes methods for handling JSON objects via 'cJSON'. It serves as an interface for managing network SSID data within a larger system.

classes.name: dm_network_ssid_t
classes.description: Class representing network SSID data and operations, including initialization, JSON encoding/decoding, comparison, and string conversion utilities.

methods.name: int init()
methods.description: Initializes the network SSID information structure by zeroing out its memory.

methods.name: em_network_ssid_info_t * get_network_ssid_info()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal 'em_network_ssid_info_t' structure holding network SSID info.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object into internal data, associating it with a parent ID.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the internal data into a cJSON object.

methods.name: haul_type_to_string
methods.description: Converts an 'em_haul_type_t' enum to its string representation.

methods.name: haul_type_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to produce the corresponding 'em_haul_type_t' enum.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks if two 'dm_network_ssid_t' instances are equal.

methods.description: Initializes a 'dm_network_ssid_t' object, optionally from an existing 'em_network_ssid_info_t'.

methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the 'dm_network_ssid_t' instance.
